fichas.title: Judo contest area
fichas.summary: Judo contest areas use soft, springy mats. For German championships and international events, the contest area is at least 10 × 10 m. Upholstered mats are not allowed; mats should ideally be raised, and the boundary between contest area and surround should be clearly visible.
